_comment: Trust anchor for the user-global Claude Code and Codex secrets guards. hooks/refresh-guard.mjs reads the canonical hooks from this directory and refuses to install any file whose sha256 differs from `files`; adapters and supplements are pinned in `local_files`. This repository is the canonical home of the guard as of 09-11-2026 (ported from agent-native-os, which pinned the same bytes by tag). A hash changes only in the same reviewed pull request as the file it pins; hooks/manifest.test.mjs fails CI when they disagree. `ref` records the reviewed change, not a download location.
_release_checklist: 1. Change the guard file and its test in one pull request.
2. In that same pull request, run `node hooks/manifest-regen.mjs` to rewrite the hashes from the LF-normalized bytes, and set `ref` to the change name.
3. Run `node hooks/manifest.test.mjs`, `node hooks/secrets-guard.test.mjs`, `node hooks/codex-secrets-guard.test.mjs`, and `node hooks/refresh-guard.test.mjs`.
4. Review the diff of both the file and the manifest together. Never update a hash without reviewing the exact source change.

5. Students receive the new guard the next time the installer prompt or `node hooks/refresh-guard.mjs` runs; both apps must be fully quit and reopened, and Codex /hooks trust reviewed again, because Codex records trust against the hook hash.
